Name: Survivalistic - Hunger and Thirst
Author: GukelZ
Description:
[b][color=#6aa84f][size=6]DESCRIPTION:[/size][/color][/b]

Adds some survival odds to the game, with different penalty and feed/hydrate values to each tool/food!


[color=#6aa84f][size=6][b]MOD FEATURES:
[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Hunger and Thirst bar.
[*]Different penaltys depending the tool you're using.
[*]Different feed and hydrate values to edible items.
[*]Support to multiplayer.
[/list]

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=6]CONFIGURATION:
[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][color=#b6d7a8]bars_position:[/color] Changes the pivot of the bars, all the pivots bellow (Remember, if you are gonna use a custom X and Y axis, change to [color=#93c47d]"custom"[/color]):
[/list] [color=#93c47d]﻿- "custom"
﻿﻿- "bottom-right"
﻿﻿- "bottom-left"
﻿﻿- "middle-right"
﻿﻿- "middle-left"
﻿﻿- "top-right"
﻿﻿- "top-left"[/color][list]
[*][color=#b6d7a8]bars_custom_x:[/color] The X position of the bars in GUI.
[*][color=#b6d7a8]bars_custom_y:[/color] The Y position of the bars in GUI.
[/list]

[color=#6aa84f][size=6][b]ACTUAL COMPATIBLE MODS:
[/b][/size][/color]
All the compatible mods are in the optional download list.


[size=4][b][color=#6aa84f]VERSIONS:[/color]
